# Mohalkar Architects & Planners

> Leading architectural design studio and urban planning consultancy based in Pune and Dharashiv, Maharashtra, India. Specializing in bespoke residential architecture, luxury bungalows, commercial complexes, landscape design, and statutory municipal sanctions.

## Organization Details
- **Full Legal Name**: Mohalkar Architects & Planners
- **Alternative Names**: Mohalkar Architects, MAP Pune, Abhishek Mohalkar Architects
- **Founding / Principal Architect**: Abhishek Mohalkar (CEO & Principal Architect)

## Core Services & Capabilities
- **Bespoke Residential Architecture**: Custom luxury bungalows, duplexes, contemporary farmhouses, and multi-family residences.
- **Commercial & Mixed-Use Design**: Office buildings, retail spaces, hospitality, and educational complexes.
- **Urban Planning & Master Planning**: Zoning, layout sub-divisions, infrastructure integration, and sustainable townships.
- **Interior Architecture**: Space planning, bespoke millwork, materiality, lighting, and turnkey finish execution.
- **Municipal Sanctions & Approvals**: Building sanctions and documentation for PMC (Pune Municipal Corporation), PCMC (Pimpri-Chinchwad Municipal Corporation), PMRDA, and regional town planning authorities across Maharashtra.
- **Engineering & Working Blueprints**: Detailed structural coordination, electrical, plumbing (MEP), and comprehensive working drawing sets.
- **3D Visualization & VR Walkthroughs**: Photorealistic exterior renderings, cinematic walkthroughs, and spatial simulations.

## Key Track Record
- 88+ Architectural & Engineering drawing sets delivered.
- Projects completed across Pune, Bhoom, Dharashiv, Solapur, and wider Maharashtra.
- 100% statutory adherence and client satisfaction.
